summary: Publication slugs cannot be claimed by another workspace or form; API conflicts return HTTP 409 without changing the original.
Publication versions advance per form across slug changes, with distinct opaque snapshot IDs and isolated submission histories.
Draft and publication writes reject route/body form identity mismatches before mutation.
Autosave keeps a newer queued edit visible when an older request completes during the debounce interval.
Nine detailed course documents and an executable API trace teach the actual code, regression reasoning, CRUD boundaries and progressive integration exercises.

checks.environment: Node 22.16.0; pnpm 9.15.4; frozen lockfile; isolated copy; Fastify injection and jsdom
checks.command: Workspace Vitest suites; lint; typecheck; build; sizecheck; seed; executable publication trace

limits: Browser fixtures and local autosave remain separate from the HTTP API; integration is a documented capstone.
Repositories remain in memory and are not coordinated across processes.
Workspace headers are not production authentication or authorization.
Submission retry handling does not yet compare changed answers for the same snapshot and key.
No live browser, deployed service, database or production identity provider was verified.
